dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Do you think I could open a stall here? I can offer a few different services... translating ancient texts, deciphering puzzles, selling miniature mechanism models...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Hmm... Sounds like a perfect retirement plan... Hmph, forget it then!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: My body and mind are still in prime condition! Retirement? Maybe in another hundred years!
